Admission enquiry

Ask on WhatsApp. The office calls you back.

Message the school’s WhatsApp in English or Hindi. The whole enquiry happens inside the chat and takes about a minute.

The enquiry records only the class you choose and your WhatsApp number, so the office can call you back. Please do not send a child’s name, marks or documents.

  1. 1

    Tap “Enquire on WhatsApp”. WhatsApp opens with “Admission enquiry” already written. Send it.

  2. 2

    Agree to a call back and type the class you are interested in.

  3. 3

    Check it and tap Send. The school office will call you back on that number.

A few questions, answered.

All parent questions →
Does submitting an enquiry reserve a seat?

No. An enquiry is a request for information. Availability, eligibility, documents and admission confirmation must be discussed with the school.

What are the fees?

Ask the office for a current, written quote for the class you are considering, including any admission, books, uniform and transport charges. The budget planner uses only amounts you enter and is not a school fee quote.

Is transport available for our area?

Please confirm your area, pick-up point, timings, charges and current route availability with the office before making plans. A route is not guaranteed by this website.

Can we visit before deciding?

Contact the office to request a campus visit. Wait for the school to confirm a suitable day and time before travelling.

Have a question about the school?Open the parent guide · four quick answers+
Which class should we ask about first?

Start with Nursery or KG. The office can help decide the appropriate class and explain age eligibility.

Fees depend on the class. Ask the office for tuition and any separate costs for books, uniform or transport. The website does not quote official fees.

Find the school opposite Mela Ground in Amet. Call before travelling so the office can confirm a suitable time.

Science, Commerce and Arts are the school’s streams. Ask the office to confirm individual subjects, eligibility and availability.
